title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts — Holding Surcharge for Batches Kept Before Being Dropped
content:
How long a shopper held an accepted batch before dropping it adds a holding surcharge to the dropped-batch violation on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Clause.** The holding surcharge counts the calendar days from the day the batch was accepted to the day it was dropped: 2 or more days add 2 points; exactly one day adds 1 point; a batch dropped on the day it was accepted adds nothing.

Both dates come from the dropped batch's record in Cartwise Shopper Batches: the acceptance time (taken as its calendar day) and the drop date.

## Condition — result

| Accepted on | Dropped on | Calendar days between | Holding surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 0 | Day 0 (the same day) | 0 | Nothing |
| Day 0 | The next calendar day | 1 | 1 point |
| Day 0 | Two calendar days later | 2 | 2 points |
| Day 0 | Five calendar days later | 5 | 2 points |

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A batch accepted at 23:40 on 4 May and dropped at 00:15 on 5 May: 1 calendar day, 1 point. The count is of calendar days.
- A batch accepted at 07:00 on 4 May and dropped at 21:00 the same day: 0 calendar days, nothing.
- A batch accepted on 4 May and dropped on 6 May: 2 calendar days, 2 points.
